variants.prompt: A barely-there, sheer black lace bikini clings to her curves as she lounges on a teak deck of a sleek, white yacht, the warm, golden glow of sunset casting long shadows across the polished wood, her wild, untamed curls billowing in the sea breeze, intense green eyes flashing with confidence as she looks directly into the camera, the DSLR capturing a sensual, full-body shot with a shallow depth of field that blurs the distant ocean horizon.
